svg.title: OpenLakeForge stage promotion
svg.desc: A developer merges a pull request into main. The build job pushes one project-code image to GHCR, or ECR on AWS, and freezes the code and that image digest into one project revision. The revision is activated in the DEV namespace and tested, then, after approval, activated unchanged in PROD. Each stage has its own buckets and catalog; both share the services in olf-system.
